title: KCET Result 2026 Out at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in, KEA Rank Card PDF and Toppers
fullContentHtml:
The Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) has announced the KCET Result 2026 on 9th June 2026 at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea. Candidates can check the KCET Result to know their qualifying status along with their marks. The Merit List has been released in the PDF format. KCET Result is a very important document as it will be needed throughout the admission process. This year, about 311,996 candidates appeared in the KCET Examination which was held on 22nd, 23rd, and 24th April, 2026. The exam was conducted in the pen and paper format for subjects like Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, and Kannada language test. Read the article below to know more about the KCET Exam Date 2026.

 KCET Result 2026 Out

The Karnataka Common Entrance Test is a state level entrance exam that takes place for getting admission in undergraduate professional programs like Engineering, Pharmacy, Agriculture, Veterinary Sciences, and many others. The Karnataka Examinations Authority has announced the KCET Results 2026 on 9th June 2026. Along with the result, candidates will also be able to check their general rank, category-wise rank and special category rank on the official website. The KCET Result Download Link has been activated on the official website. Candidates must check each and every detail mentioned on the admit card properly, and in case of any kind of any discrepancy, they must immediately contact the exam conducting authority. The results are out for those candidates who have appeared in the KCET Examination.

Direct Link to Check KCET Result 2026

kea.kar.nic.in 2026 Result: Overview

The KCET KEA Result 2026 has been made available on the official portals kea.kar.nic.in, cetonline.karnataka.gov.in and karresults.nic.in. Applicants are advised to carefully review their scores and download the official rank card, which will be required for subsequent stages of the admission and counselling process to various undergraduate professional courses across Karnataka.

KEA KCET Result 2026: Official website to Check

Candidates who appeared for the KCET 2026 exam can now check their results online through the official websites. To access their scorecards and rank details, they need to enter their application number. The KCET 2026 results are available on the following websites:

  • cetonline.karnataka.gov.in
  • karresults.nic.in
  • www.kea.kar.nic.in.

How to Check KCET Results 2026 at kea.kar.nic.in?

The KCET result sheet has the scores of the candidate according to each subject, total scores and KCET ranking, which becomes important during counseling and seat allocation. Check below the complete process:

Step 1: Visit the official website of KEA – kea.kar.nic.in, cetonline.karnataka.gov.in, karresults.nic.in.

Step 2: On the homepage, click on the link that says “KCET 2026 Result”

Step 3: Enter the registration number and the first four characters of the name

Step 4: Click on “Submit”

Step 5: Karnataka CET result 2026 will be displayed on the screen

Step 6: Download the KCET exam result 2026 and take a printout

Checkout: KCET Exam Pattern 2026

What Details are Mentioned on the KCET Result 2026?

The KCET 2026 result provides comprehensive details about a candidate’s performance in the entrance exam. It includes:

  • Student’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Date of Birth
  • School Name & Code
  • Examination
  • Subject-wise Marks
  • Total Marks
  • Grade / Grade Points
  • Result Status
  • Remarks (if any)
  • Authority’s Signature
  • KCET Rank

KCET Cut Off 2026

Once the KCET 2026 examination results are declared, then the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) will also declare the KCET cut off. The cut-off marks denote the lowest rank that a candidate needs to secure to be eligible for getting admissions in the desired course at the college level. Candidates are advised to visit the official KEA website from time to time to get updated about the counselling procedure and other related matters.

How to Challenge KCET Result 2026?

If candidates notice any mistakes in their KCET 2026 results, they can raise objections. Objections can be submitted in the following cases:

  • Change or error in the qualifying exam marks
  • Missing rank in the KCET 2026 result
  • The incorrect version code is marked on the KCET question paper

Candidates must submit their objections within three days of the result announcement. All challenges must be made following the official guidelines provided by KEA.

KEA KCET Rank List 2026

The KCET Rank List 2026 has been released by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), along with the release of the results. This rank list consists of the names as well as the ranks of those candidates whose performance in the KCET 2026 entrance test and the qualifying marks in the 2nd PUC/ Class 12 board examinations (as per the applicable streams) have been recorded. Moreover, the KCET Rank List 2026 has been released, listing out the ranks of all those qualified candidates in different streams like Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy.

What’s Next After KCET Results 2026?

Those who qualify the criteria for cut-off marks will become eligible for the KCET Counseling Process that is going to commence shortly after the announcement of results. The counseling process involves various stages, which include:

  • Document Verification at designated KEA helpline centers.
  • Option Entry, where students choose the courses they prefer and colleges as well.
  • Mock Allotment, which helps students get a fair idea about the whole allotment process.
  • Seat Allotment based on merit, preference and availability.
  • Reporting at the college allotted.

The candidates must make sure that all the necessary documentation has been prepared by them, such as their KCET score card, marksheets of SSLC (10th) and 2nd PUC/12th, caste/category certificate, if required, study certificates, and valid identity proof. The candidates must keep themselves informed about the dates of counselling through the KEA website.

How is KCET rank calculated?

KEA will calculate the KCET 2026 rank based on marks obtained by candidates in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics subjects in KCET 2026 and the marks obtained by candidates in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics subjects in the Qualifying Examination, taken in equal proportions.

KCET Counselling 2026

The KEA is going to conduct the counselling for KCET 2026 in an online manner. Students, who qualify according to their KCET 2026 results, can participate in this counselling process. This counselling procedure involves processes like online registration, verification of documents, choice filling, and locking of the choice. Selection process will be done depending on the rank and preference of the students.

Students Advised to Monitor Official KEA Portal

Candidates should regularly check the official KEA website for updates on counselling registration, seat matrix, document verification, mock allotment results, and final seat allotment schedules.

KCET Results 2026 FAQs

Q1. Where can I check the KCET 2026 result?

You can check the KCET 2026 result on the official websites: kea.kar.nic.in, cetonline.karnataka.gov.in, and karresults.nic.in.

Q2. What details do I need to check my KCET 2026 result?

To access your result, you need your Karnataka CET application/registration number and the first four letters of your name.

Q3. What information is mentioned in the KCET result?

The KCET 2026 result contains:

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Subject-wise Marks
  • Total Marks
  • KCET Rank

Q4. Will I receive a hard copy of my KCET rank card?

No. KEA will not provide any physical rank cards at its office. You must download and print the result from the official website.

Q5. What should be done in case of error in KCET results?

If you have noticed any discrepancies (such as missing ranks, marks errors), then raise an objection before KEA within three days from the day results are declared through official website.

Q6. How is KCET ranking decided?

KCET rank 2026 is determined on the basis of equal weightage of marks scored in KCET (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) and marks scored in qualifying examination (PUC/12th).

Q7. When will KCET 2026 counselling begin?

Counselling will start shortly after the result declaration. The schedule will be announced on the KEA website. It includes document verification, option entry, mock allotment, and final seat allotment.
